title: Lighting Lab
description: Read-only lighting research and explicitly armed stationary experiments with retained restore evidence

screens.title: Lighting Lab
screens.name: MAIN
items: DISARMED: waiting for fresh standstill evidence
Read-only observation. No automatic lighting commands.

screens.title: Read-only observation
screens.name: OBSERVE
items: Select a provider, then a field. Unknown/unavailable providers and missing fields do not establish hardware capability. Observation and refresh send no lighting writes.

screens.title: Raw field detail
screens.name: FIELD
items: Freshness is observation age, not a physical measurement guarantee. Notification-only fields cannot be actively read; wait for a notification. Getter errors are not provider absence.
Open complete raw payload and metadata

screens.title: Stationary experiments
screens.name: EXPERIMENT
items: Editing a draft sends nothing. A live provider, valid restorable original, durable evidence, fresh exact-zero speed and explicit short-lived arming are required before Apply. One unresolved trial at a time.

screens.title: Edit experiment value
screens.name: EDITOR
items: All edits remain local until explicit Apply confirmation.
Load valid current value into draft

screens.title: Edit numeric raw draft
screens.name: NUMBER
items: Local draft only: no write or automatic sweep. Steps clamp at the permitted range. Return to the editor to review the explicit Apply request.

screens.title: Choose draft value
screens.name: VALUE
items: This changes the draft only. Native menu/profile names are not renamed. Factory numbers and raw codes do not establish visible colors.

screens.title: Confirm stationary Apply
screens.name: APPLY
items: Keep the vehicle stationary and inspect the actual lights safely. Raw controls can have unknown side effects. This creates a retained trial BEFORE dispatch; failures and unknown outcomes remain unresolved. No automatic restore on hide, exit, crash or restart.
Send this one armed stationary trial

screens.title: Baseline and evidence
screens.name: BASELINE
items: Baseline capture and snapshot are read-only evidence operations. They do not restore lights. Restore uses the retained trial's original value and persisted plan, not an arbitrary snapshot.
Inspect retained trial / before / after / restore plan

screens.title: Trial and research history
screens.name: HISTORY
items: Physical confirmation is your independent observation of the requested effect. It is not transport success and does not resolve the retained trial. Restore still requires explicit rearming.
Record stock change / brightness / zone color note

screens.title: Research annotation
screens.name: ANNOTATE
items: Select only what you physically observed. Stock-menu changes are evidence labels, not app commands or confirmed raw-to-color mappings. Capture a snapshot to retain corresponding raw readings.

screens.title: Observed physical zone
screens.name: ZONE
items: Choose the actual observed zone, not a presumed layer mapping. The app does not claim independent control of these zones.

screens.title: Explicit stationary arming
screens.name: ARM
items: Arming sends no lighting command. It permits one explicitly requested stationary Apply or Restore for about 30 seconds, subject to fresh exact-zero raw speed, provider continuity, visibility and working evidence storage. Re-arm separately before Restore. Preview cannot arm. Do not use while driving.

screens.title: Explicit trial Restore
screens.name: RESTORE
items: Restore is an explicit vehicle write and requires fresh rearming and standstill. Legacy restore sends all valid known original color-control fields together; unknown/unfilled fields are withheld. Profile restore returns the selected field. Exterior mode restore returns the original normal switch mode and any valid captured fog states in the saved plan; a fog-only trial restores that fog state. Inspect the plan, physical lamps, fog and possible side effects separately. Failed or unverified restores stay unresolved.
Send retained trial's armed Restore now

screens.title: Safety and scope
screens.name: HELP
items: Use only while safely stationary. Observation is read-only; experiments require explicit short-lived arming and fresh raw speed exactly zero. This app does not bypass any >15 mph restriction, stock speed gate or vehicle interlock. It never spoofs speed or injects CAN/diagnostics.

Catalog definitions are not proof of installed hardware, provider availability or physical response. Newer profile and exterior providers may be unavailable. Unknown is distinct from unavailable. LampExterior2 is observation only; there are no high-beam, laser, aiming or diagnostic command buttons.

Raw values are not RGB, hue degrees or a proven brightness percentage. Legacy hue is restricted to 0..4094; layers and brightness to 0..253, with reserved/unproven 254/255 withheld. A reserved original blocks that control's trial. Native menu/profile names are not renamed. Factory selections and profile IDs have no invented color names or zone mappings.

Capture a baseline, select one value, arm, then explicitly Apply. The original and planned restore are saved before dispatch. A setter acknowledgement is not physical success; fresh readback is separate, and exterior requests also require matching feedback. Record physical yes/no/uncertain independently. Only one unresolved trial is allowed; reconnect/new trials/baseline overwrite remain blocked until Restore resolves it.

Hiding, moving, stale speed, provider loss, timeout or logging failure disarms. Disarm does not restore. There is NO automatic restore after disconnect, hide, exit, crash or restart: the trial remains available for deliberate stationary rearming and Restore. A restored raw state cannot prove all physical side effects reversed. Inspect fog states and lamps separately.

Use stock controls manually while parked, annotate stock menu/brightness changes and actual zone colors, then save snapshots. Notes are observation evidence only. Individual raw-control side effects remain unknown. Logs omit GPS/private fields and bound reading samples; evidence-storage errors prohibit experiments. No automatic sweeps, driving-mode automation or background writes.
